descriptionHtml:
ST-Standard ICE-06N RGB High-Performance Gaming Laptop Cooling Pad (6-Fan Powerful Thermal Array / Dynamic RGB Accent Lighting / Digital LCD Control Panel / Multi-Position Ergonomic Stand / Dual USB Ports / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Eliminate thermal bottlenecks and maintain high clock speeds on your gaming setup with the ST-Standard ICE-06N RGB High-Performance Gaming Laptop Cooling Pad, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Engineered with a durable iron mesh top surface combined with a high-impact ABS structural frame, this versatile cooling stand accommodates laptops up to 17 Inch display sizes effortlessly. Equipped with an efficient 6-fan high-speed active cooling matrix, it channels massive airflow directly across your laptop ventilation intake zones to dissipate heat during intense gaming or heavy workload rendering. The pad highlights dynamic RGB side lighting strip effects to perfectly blend into modern gaming station aesthetics. Featuring an integrated LCD digital display for real-time fan power adjustment, ergonomic height elevation support, and dual USB pass-through ports, this whisper-quiet thermal pad provides maximum reliability.
